records.title: Use of Hospital Patient and Family Advisory Councils: A Scoping Study
records.citation_ama11: Lewis B, Cochran C, Marquez E, et al. Use of hospital patient and family advisory councils: a scoping study. J Patient Exp. 2025;12:23743735251316995. doi:10.1177/23743735251316995
records.rationale: PFAC history anchor. The study identifies Boston Children's Hospital as one of the first hospitals to establish a PFAC, in 1982, and reviews 143 articles on hospital PFAC use, engagement, measurement, and success factors.
